answer: A farm must buy five people, ten climbs, thirty signatures — in eighteen minutes. Each epoch, twenty-four juniper staircases spiral to an opal vein. A claimant climbs twelve steps, each showing a fresh cut seeded by the last block and the step before — nothing can be pre-answered; three strangers sign the climb, two climbs each. Entry is 75 POA, +50 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 3,000 POA. One operator climbs two at most. A missed step burns 25 and restarts it; one cut on two staircases voids both bonds. Times match funding roots: ten climbs, one root, one claim.
